measurements.name: collect
measurements.source:
-- Build a List with collecting, then iterate it for a checksum.
on run n
  repeat for each i in 1..n collecting i into values
  end repeat
  put 0 into total
  repeat for each v in values
    add v to total
  end repeat
  return total
end run
